meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接入一个 DeltaChat 机器人邮箱,通过邮件收发消息并做端到端加密。它能处理一对一私聊和群组消息、收发文件附件,并支持用 /set-avatar 改头像。
howto.when: 需要给 Claude 接入 DeltaChat 邮箱时使用:在 .env 填好 DC_EMAIL 等凭据并重启服务,联系人通过邀请链接或二维码完成 SecureJoin 后,该会话被接管。

say.text: 帮我配好 DeltaChat 的 .env 凭据并重启服务
say.note: 重启后适配器会配置邮箱并输出邀请链接

say.text: 找一下 DeltaChat 机器人的邀请链接和二维码
say.note: 链接写在日志,二维码存为 invite-qr.svg

say.text: 运行 /init-first-agent 接入 DeltaChat 私聊
say.note: 会创建用户记录并完成 wiring

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude connects to a DeltaChat bot mailbox and exchanges messages over email with end-to-end encryption. It handles 1:1 chats and groups, sends and receives file attachments, and supports /set-avatar.
howto.when_en: Use when adding a DeltaChat email channel to Claude: set DC_EMAIL credentials in .env, restart, and the chat is taken over once a contact finishes SecureJoin via invite link or QR code.

say_en.text: Set up the DeltaChat .env credentials and restart the service
say_en.note: Adapter configures the mailbox and logs the invite link

say_en.text: Find the bot's DeltaChat invite link and QR code
say_en.note: Link is in the logs; QR is invite-qr.svg

say_en.text: Run /init-first-agent to wire the DeltaChat DM
say_en.note: Creates the user record and the wiring
